title: Ecuador | World Coffee Guide
description: High-grown Ecuadorian coffee can be delicate and floral, with citrus and a sweetness that surprises people who have never ordered it. It is a small origin, mostly arabica from the Andes, with Loja in the south the best-known region, and there is also robusta grown in the Amazon.
seoDescription: Ecuador coffee guide: Loja, Zaruma, Sidra, Amazon robusta, USDA production.
